decision.reason: Roads and trails share reusable linear-route behavior—continuity, junctions, crossings, shoulders/clearance, route-condition and chokepoint logic—that is lighter and more general than ARCH-INFRASTRUCTURE and is not supplied by surrounding terrain archetypes.

archetypes.name: Transport Corridor
archetypes.baseline_scope: Linear terrestrial movement corridors such as roads, trails and maintained routes whose continuity, junctions, crossings, shoulders, grades and route condition structure navigation without assuming heavy industrial machinery or dense urban fabric.
reusable_behavior: linear route continuity and directional travel
shoulder/clearance and edge interaction with surrounding terrain
excluded_or_deferred: landslide, flood, wildfire or other active disaster overlays
evidence_basis: ENV-03 explicit road/trail corridor watch item
existing Skeletons of Highways source preset demonstrates transport-route structure but is too post-apocalyptic/infrastructure-specific to serve as the generic corridor identity
ENV-10 Road / Wilderness Trail requires reusable route behavior across rural, wilderness and settled contexts
